description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit fundraising campaign records with the results reported for them: each campaign with its id, reference, name, period, the total its result reports, the currency, whether the result reports the total gross or net of campaign costs and whether it reports the campaign as recurring revenue; each gift record credited to a campaign with its id, reference, the campaign, donor, amount, period and whether the gift record shows a recurring gift; each campaign cost with its id, the campaign, amount, period and what it paid for. The signed report gives the campaigns and the gifts, each reported total recomputed from the gift records credited to the campaign, gross or net of its costs as the result states, each campaign cost’s period against the periods the campaign’s revenue falls in, each result labeled net against the gross figure, and each campaign reported as recurring revenue against the recurring gifts the records show, and counts them, and names divergent fundraising records: a campaign total that does not recompute from the gift records, a campaign cost recorded in a different period than the revenue, a result reported gross where the records give it net, and a campaign reported as recurring revenue when the records show one-time gifts; then a gift or cost naming a campaign the records do not hold and a campaign reporting a total with no gift records beneath it, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No campaigns or a campaign with no reported total leaves those points unverified. Campaigns, gifts and costs match by letters and digits, amounts add to the cent, and periods compare without case, punctuation or word order with quarters and month names folded. This reads whether each campaign result the organization reports recomputes from its own gift and cost records. Verdict nonprofit_fundraising_divergent, nonprofit_fundraising_partial, nonprofit_fundraising_unverified or nonprofit_fundraising_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-fundraising-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
